svg.text: Each floor (and its terraces) coloured by what carries it, drawn over the walls, beams and columns of the storey below. Dark lines = bearing walls below. Squares = columns. Grid = the structural grid. Drawn in the design frame: east (downhill) to the right, south down.
ROAD LEVEL 1677.50 over the main floor
Garage, hall, office and the roof terrace stand on the main floor's walls.
Road Level floor 133 m²: wall 44, span 88
suspended deck 19 m²: wall 6, span 12, cantilever 1
MAIN FLOOR 1673.60 over the lower floor
Day rooms and terraces stand on the lower floor's walls and the v 13.0 beam; the west part on dug ground.
Main Floor floor 207 m²: ground 61, wall 57, span 90
South Terrace 35 m²: wall 12, span 22, cantilever 2
Dug ground in the west; the east is a suspended slab on foundation walls over a crawl void.
Lower Floor floor 170 m²: ground 157, wall 5, span 8
directly on a wall or beam below
suspended slab over a ventilated crawl void (never filled)
bearing wall or beam of the storey below (the lines the check uses)
